doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27

title: Jimmy Kennell and a week of seven jobs
summary: Brief talk about the seven jobs in a day and cornetist Jimmy Kennell.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: I remember hearing about it. Seven jobs, seven jobs including the ball.
What was his name, Mom? Kennell? Yeah, Jimmy Kennell. Jimmy Kennell?
You don't know Jimmy Kennell do you? No. He was a little kid too. He was a little fella too.
Jimmy Kennell. He played cornet too. He played with him too?
